scenarios.action: User attempts to generate a new itinerary in Airplane Mode
scenarios.expected_behavior: Displays canonical message: 'Trip planning requires an internet connection. Your saved trips remain available offline.'

scenarios.action: Cold launch Discover tab without internet and without prior cache
scenarios.expected_behavior: Displays honest empty state: 'Connection required to discover new places. Saved places and transit schedules remain available.'

scenarios.action: Open Map tab in Airplane Mode without cached vector tiles
scenarios.expected_behavior: Map renders linear list sheet with notice: 'Map tiles are unavailable offline. Saved places and previously available local content can still be viewed.'

scenarios.action: Launch app offline with stored session token
scenarios.expected_behavior: Restores cached identity for display in You tab without asserting remote validity; fails open without forcing logout.

scenarios.action: View place detail for coordinates with no cached weather
scenarios.expected_behavior: Displays 'Weather unavailable offline'; never fabricates 0°C or Sunny.
